source: Negrita FITNESS FOOD menu, transcribed from photographs
note: Descriptions only. Prices and macros on this menu were checked against the database and already matched exactly (25/25 prices, 124/125 macro values), so nothing else was changed. The one exception, Bulking at 765 vs 755 kcal, was left at the database value at the restaurant's request.
menu_note: Weights and macros are estimated from raw ingredients before cooking.
brand_note: Organic chicken. Grass fed beef. No seed oil. Organic locally grown veggies. Omega eggs.

section_notes.kebab_combo: Includes a skewer, onion paratha, hummus, tzatziki, grilled mixed vegetables, Kalamata and Halkidiki olives, and pickled cucumber. Free choice of 2 sauces: chimichurri, Negrita Island Sauce, spicy mayo, mustard, teriyaki.

descriptions.greek_god_tenderloin: Tomato, garlic, onion, salt, pepper. Georgian marinated (Jaku Legacy grass-fed).
descriptions.greek_god_wagyu: Kofta Delhi — parsley, salt, pepper, onion, baharat (Vintage Galician grass-fed).
descriptions.greek_god_salmon: Tasmanian salmon with zucchini and paprika. Choice of chimichurri or shio kombu marinade.
descriptions.greek_god_scallops: Orkney scallops with paprika and onion. Choice of chimichurri or shio kombu marinade.
descriptions.before_cardio: Grilled banana with cinnamon, fruit cuts, honeycomb, and two-time-cooked scrambled egg whites on 10K toast.
descriptions.recovery_salmon: Pan-seared salmon trout 200 g, grilled asparagus 30 g, jasmine rice 150 g.
descriptions.bali_boy: A rice bowl with jasmine rice 200 g and ayam sayur (pulled chicken 200 g), two-time-cooked — steamed then sautéed with heritage Bali coconut oil, Bali spices, chili and kaffir lime. Double chicken for 50K adds 62 g protein.
descriptions.beef_ritual_burger: A real grass-fed 300 g Wagyu AUS smash patty, triple American cheddar cheese, baby romaine, pickles, jalapeño, potato bun 80 g.
descriptions.peri_peri_chicken: Organic free-range chicken breast 300 g, homemade low-fat yogurt, peri-peri sauce, jasmine rice 150 g, sautéed wild mushrooms 100 g.
descriptions.unagi_shogun: Muscle repair. A 200 g portion of Japanese freshwater eel: high-quality protein plus omega-3 fats, high in vitamins A and B12, and a source of iron and calcium.
descriptions.cheese_cake: Low-fat cottage cheese syrniki (Slavic pancake) 100 g, whey powder 20 g, stevia berry compote 20 g, sour cream 20 g (1 pc).
descriptions.protein_banana_bread: Banana bread with organic bananas, almond flour and dates (sugar-free), 30 g protein powder. Served with creamy Greek yogurt.
descriptions.special_protein_pancake: A stack of 3 pancakes, 300 g, with 30 g whey protein, berry compote sweetened with stevia, seasonal fruits, banana, cacao and ice cream.
descriptions.protein_bountiful_fruit_waffle: Waffle bread 300 g with 30 g whey protein, berry compote sweetened with stevia, seasonal fruits, banana, cacao and ice cream.
descriptions.oatmeal_banana_peanut_butter: Rolled oats cooked with fresh milk and peanut butter, garnished with crunchy roasted almonds and strawberries, with 30 g whey protein.
descriptions.oatmeal_baked_apple_cinnamon: Rolled oats cooked with fresh milk and peanut butter, garnished with crunchy roasted almonds and strawberries, with 30 g whey protein. Baked apple and cinnamon.
descriptions.bulking_chicken: 2 soft-boiled omega-3 eggs, organic avocado half-slice, dressing with EVOO, pumpkin seeds.
descriptions.geisha: Organic free-range chicken breast teriyaki 300 g, 150 g organic jasmine rice, boiled organic broccoli 100 g, kyuri, cherry tomato.
descriptions.breakfast_protein_burrito: Tortilla bread, sliced avocado, cucumber, baby romaine and grilled organic free-range chicken breast 250 g.
descriptions.chicken_pita: Two pieces of half pita bread 100 g filled with grilled chicken 300 g, tomato, julienne carrot, Kalamata olives, mixed salad, sesame dressing and Parmesan cheese.
descriptions.thai_boy_beefy: Pad Krapao stir beef basil style with Wagyu on an onion bed, jasmine rice 150 g, 2 sunny-side-up omega-3 eggs, Thai corn 50 g.
descriptions.thai_boy_chicky: Pad Krapao stir chicken basil style with organic free-range chicken 300 g, steamed jasmine rice 150 g, 2 sunny-side-up omega-3 eggs, sweet Thai corn 50 g.
descriptions.buckwheat_bluefin_tuna: Ukrainian organic buckwheat 200 g, cucumber, lettuce, cherry tomato, bluefin tuna tataki 150 g.
descriptions.buckwheat_chicken_teriyaki: Ukrainian organic buckwheat 200 g, organic free-range chicken breast 200 g sautéed with paprika, 1 boiled egg, sweet corn 20 g.
